risks.title: Third-party vendor data handling
risks.businessImpact: Potential breach of customer data affecting GDPR and HIPAA obligations. Customer contracts require us to ensure sub-processors maintain equivalent security standards. Non-compliance could result in contract termination by enterprise customers.
risks.mitigationStatus: In progress — Datadog report requested March 2026, pending receipt. Zendesk renewal confirmed for July 2026.

risks.title: Incident response plan not tested
risks.businessImpact: In the event of a security incident, an untested response plan increases the risk of delayed containment, poor communications, and regulatory notification failures. GDPR requires breach notification within 72 hours.
risks.mitigationStatus: Scheduling in progress — tabletop exercise targeted for August 2026 with external facilitator.

risks.title: Critical vulnerability remediation SLA breach
risks.businessImpact: Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to impersonate authenticated users. Affects approximately 12% of customer sessions that use the specific authentication flow.
risks.mitigationStatus: Patch in QA environment. Production deployment scheduled for July 5, 2026. Compensating control (enhanced session monitoring) active.

risks.title: Change management process gaps
risks.businessImpact: Deployments without security review create a window for insecure code to reach production. Historical data shows 23% of deployments with skipped security review introduced a vulnerability.
risks.mitigationStatus: Engineering lead implementing mandatory security review gate in CI/CD pipeline. Expected completion Q3 2026.

risks.title: Security training compliance gap
risks.businessImpact: Undertrained employees are significantly more likely to fall victim to phishing and social engineering attacks. Our last phishing simulation showed a 6.2% click rate versus 2.1% for fully trained employees.
risks.mitigationStatus: Automated reminders sent. HR escalating to managers of non-compliant employees. Deadline is June 30.

risks.title: Laptop MDM enrollment incomplete
risks.businessImpact: Unmanaged laptops accessing corporate resources create risk if a device is lost or stolen. Customer data could be exposed if an unencrypted device is compromised.
risks.mitigationStatus: IT department has scheduled enrollment for all three devices by July 5, 2026.

risks.title: Supplier questionnaires overdue
risks.businessImpact: Without current questionnaires, we cannot confirm these vendors maintain security controls aligned with our requirements. Regulatory auditors have flagged vendor risk gaps in past assessments.
risks.mitigationStatus: Questionnaires sent to all 4 vendors. Intercom responded; under review. 3 pending.

risks.title: Control documentation not current post-restructure
risks.businessImpact: Out-of-date documentation creates audit findings and can undermine our SOC 2 attestation if auditors identify inconsistencies between documented and actual controls.
risks.mitigationStatus: Compliance team updating all affected documentation. 40% complete as of June 29.
